evals.prompt: Edit content — review these caption variants and select or lightly edit the strongest for Instagram publication.
evals.expected_output: JSON with selected caption, rationale, and optional light edits; no hashtag appending.
assertions: Selects one variant or produces a light edit with editorial rationale
Does not append hashtags to the selected caption
Brand voice check — first person plural, no clichés from avoid list
Does not generate new variants from scratch (that is write-captions)
